subject: Mutual action plan: security gate playbook (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma@mercurybank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan: security gate playbook (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is the first-cut mutual action plan (MAP_master_v1.xlsx) that breaks the evaluation and close timeline into three lanes: Security & Compliance, Legal & Contracting, and Technical Staging. High-level asks we want to lock this week so we have a realistic close timeline:

- SOC 2: we will scope Redwood's current SOC 2 Type II report (security + availability) as evidence for the acceptance gate. We can provide the report + point-in-time evidence (SOC2_evidence_index.pdf) by 11/22.
- SIG / CAIQ: we will complete the CAIQ-style SIG questionnaire and flag any open control items by 11/18.
- DPA: please send any redlines back ASAP. We received your note that legal will propose a few targeted changes; if we can get redlines by end of day Monday (11/15) we will aim to return with agreed language by 11/19.
- Data retention: you asked about divergent retention windows. Redwood supports per-data-class retention mapping; see the retention_matrix.csv we've started. Our default proposal for financial customers is 7 years for transactional data, 3 years for aggregated logs, and 90 days for ephemeral debug traces — but we can adjust based on your audit obligations.

Next steps: can we confirm the acceptance gate items you need for a procurement sign-off? If you confirm DPA + SOC2 + SIG completion as the primary gate items, the target go-live we discussed (12/10) is achievable.

I've cc'd Jonas (technical lead) and Kimberly (security & legal ops) so they can pick up follow-ups.

Attachments: MAP_master_v1.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_index.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Barnes <emma@mercurybank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@mercurybank.com
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security gate playbook (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the MAP and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) Data retention: our compliance team requires a split between transaction data (7 years minimum) and customer-identifying metadata (5 years), with separate retention for logs (3 years). Is Redwood able to enforce retention per data class and produce attestations for deletion?

2) SOC 2: we need confirmation of coverage for subservice providers and whether there's a scoped list of controls (we'll need the report and a control matrix). If you can deliver the SOC2_evidence_index.pdf that maps report sections to our control requests, that will speed review.

3) SIG / CAIQ: we typically deliver a preliminary questionnaire to our vendors; can Redwood fill the CAIQ and mark any 'partial' answers?

4) DPA: attaching our redline (Mercury_DPA_redlines.docx). Our legal team has a couple of asks around data exportability and breach notification timelines (48 hours).

If you can confirm the plan for each item and proposed deadlines, we'll route internally. We appreciate the proposed 12/10 go-live but procurement will need firm commitments on the gate dates.

Thanks — Emma
Senior Procurement Manager
Mercury Bank
emma@mercurybank.com

Attachment: Mercury_DPA_redlines.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security gate playbook (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Irene / Jonas —

Reviewed Mercury's redline (quick pass). Summary: most DPA redlines are standard and acceptable, except Section 4.2 (we disagree on retention carveouts that would push ownership to us beyond our standard limits). Proposed approach:

- We accept their breach notification timeline of 48 hours but will add a clause for "reasonable efforts" to gather facts and provide a full report in 5 business days.
- Retention: we will propose the per-data-class retention table (attached retention_matrix.csv) as the operational commitment and mark any items requiring engineering changes with a separate ETA.
- Subservice providers / SOC2: we will provide the SOC 2 report and a minimal subservice list. For any third-party that is critical to a control, we'll provide mitigation details.

Action items for legal / contract:
- Laura: can you take point on a focused redline response for 11/19? We'll circulate tracked changes back to Mercury Legal.
- Jonas: please confirm we can implement per-data-class enforcement (policy + delete flows) and list any items that need an engineering sprint.

Attachments: retention_matrix.csv

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma@mercurybank.com>, legal@mercurybank.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan: security gate playbook (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention) — updated MAP & deadlines

Emma / team —

Thanks for the prompt review and the redlines. Quick summary and agreed timeline so everyone is aligned: 

Decisions / commitments:
- DPA: Redwood will return a tracked DPA response by 2027-11-19. Laura will lead the redline response and Kimberly will confirm technical feasibility for any retention-related asks.
- SOC 2: Redwood will deliver the SOC2 Type II report and the SOC2_evidence_index.pdf (mapping to Mercury's control list) by 2027-11-22.
- SIG / CAIQ: Redwood will populate the CAIQ-format SIG answers and flag partials by 2027-11-18.
- Data retention: agreed to use the per-data-class retention_matrix.csv as the baseline. We recognize Mercury requires: 7y transaction, 5y customer metadata, 3y logs; Redwood will provide deletion attestations for each class and a mapping of retention enforcement responsibilities. Any engineering changes required will be listed with ETA in the reply on 11/19.

Updated close timeline (conditional on above):
- 11/19: DPA tracked response + list of any engineering items
- 11/22: SOC2 evidence package delivered
- 11/25: Procurement/Legal final review
- Target go-live: 12/10 (soft, contingent on procurement sign-off)

Attachments included in this thread: MAP_master_v1.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_index.pdf, retention_matrix.csv.

If this looks correct I'll push the updated MAP to the shared Drive and create the HubSpot milestone for the 11/19 DPA response.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this out promptly.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Note: this thread contains internal and external recipients limited to sales, security, and legal as appropriate.
